newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's east Prairies saw heavy rain, hail - EC.
newsitem.headline: Canada's east Prairies saw heavy rain, hail - EC.

text.p: Canada's eastern Prairie grainbelt saw half an inch to four inches of rain and an inch of hail late Wednesday in a severe thunderstorm system, an Environment Canada meteorologist said.

There were no reports of tornadoes but one inch of hail was recorded in southeastern Saskatchewan around Carievale while that region and southwestern Manitoba saw an average 12 mm (0.5 inch) of rain, meteorologist Karen Dewar said.
Ashern, in Manitoba's Interlake region, saw 100 mm (4.0 inches) of rain with unconfirmed reports of up to six inches due to a "very localized" thunderstorm system, Dewar said.
